description: This file is a build script written in JavaScript, specifically using the ECMAScript Module syntax. It manages build-related tasks such as cleaning symlinks, running external commands, and handling build errors.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within extensions directories under a given root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes stale runtime overlay symlinks in build directories to prevent issues during rebuilds.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Parses lines of build output to find unresolved import errors that are outside the project extensions directory.
